facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Before Sara arrived, Lavinia was the most admired student at Miss Minchin's school. Her wealth and her confidence made everyone want to impress her and earn her approval. She had never once seriously imagined that her position might change or disappear. Then Sara arrived with greater wealth and a natural warmth that drew everyone toward her. Lavinia lost her special position almost overnight and felt something she had never felt before. She had based her whole sense of self on being the most important person in the room. When that position was taken, she discovered just how fragile that foundation had always been. Privilege is not permanent.
